_comment: Asserted by adapters/railgun/scripts/check-sdk-test-count.sh: a test file that
silently stops being collected (rename, bad include glob, a describe left as
.skip) turns the sdk-tests lane green with less running — this file is what
catches the number drifting. `passed` is a floor (new tests may land before this
file is bumped); `skipped`, `testFiles` and `skippedFiles` are EXACT.
The 21 skipped tests / 3 skipped files are the intentionally env-gated live tier:
live_latency_bench.test.ts (1); CI sets none of their RAVEN_LIVE_* env vars.
Anything else skipped is a regression, not a policy.
